_note: This is the correct Long Beach form for solar - page 2 has a dedicated 'E12 New Rooftop Mounted Solar PV System' row with kW DC/AC, module count, microinverter count, combiner box count, panel-upgrade size, and ESS kWh fields, plus a One-Family/Two-Family building-type checkbox pair (Check Box28/29) scoped to that row. Only kW DC, kW AC, module count, and the One-Family checkbox have a real JNB source - microinverter count, combiner box count, panel-upgrade amperage, and ESS kWh aren't tracked anywhere in JNB and are left unmapped rather than guessed (GUARDRAILS.md rule 2). kW AC uses solar_kw_ac_only (pure AC, no DC fallback), not solar_kw_ac - same duplicate-value fix applied to Corona during Phase B (2026-09-12), since this row shows DC and AC side by side. Check Box29 (Two-Family) also unmapped - no JNB signal distinguishes a duplex from a single-family job. The other 27 checkboxes in the Description-Number grid (E1-E11) cover unrelated electrical work categories (subpanel swaps, EVCS, lighting/wiring alterations) - out of scope, left unmapped. Page 1's 13-way occupancy-classification grid is entirely unmapped, same reasoning as app-011 (no reliable signal to pick 1 of 13, and solar_use.sfd is already spent on the E12 row's own One-Family checkbox below - a schema key can only map to one PDF field per mapping file). Signature block left blank (GUARDRAILS.md rule 3).
